|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 of [[Zuckuss With Snare Rifle]] (version 2 of 3). The image here is the slip on the Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata (Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf) (PDF created 2 August 2024), cut unchanged from page 1. The current text is [[Zuckuss With Snare Rifle (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).
* '''Original''' ([[Zuckuss With Snare Rifle]]): the card image at official release (20 December 2023)<ref name="ht-73ae2bd">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/73ae2bd94d3bb50c349b1a37df01b994962a4a80/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Dark/large/zuckusswithsnarerifle.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual23-Dark/large/zuckusswithsnarerifle.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/73ae2bd94d3bb50c349b1a37df01b994962a4a80 73ae2bd] “Set 23 Preview”, 20 December 2023.</ref> prints: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Once per game, may peek at top card of any Reserve Deck. Permanent weapon is •Zuckuss’ Snare Rifle (may target a character for free; draw destiny; target excluded from battle if destiny +1 &gt; target’s power).”<ref name="cj-8d3b539">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/8d3b539 swccg-card-json commit 8d3b539] “Set 23 Preview and December 2023 Errata” (21 December 2023) first gave the card this wording.</ref> The card image prints no errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata (Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf)<ref name="sheet23-20240802">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 9 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file created 2 August 2024). Released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 1, file created 2 August 2024: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Once per game, may peek at top card of any Reserve Deck. Permanent weapon is •Zuckuss' Snare Rifle (may target a character for free; draw destiny; target excluded from battle if destiny +1 &gt; target's power).” '''What changed:''' Changed words: the slip is the first publication of the wording of the card image [[Zuckuss With Snare Rifle (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2), which the PC published after the sheet. The game text words are unchanged. The sheet PDF was created at 05:53 UTC on 2 August 2024, before the card image [[Zuckuss With Snare Rifle (Errata 2)]] was uploaded (06:12 UTC, 2 August 2024). Under the label “•Zuckuss With Snare Rifle” the sheet prints, pixel for pixel, the card image that the PC uploaded shortly afterwards as [[Zuckuss With Snare Rifle (Errata 2)]] (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Zuckuss With Snare Rifle (Errata 2)]]): the errata card image (2 August 2024)<ref name="ht-0151016">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/01510164a92d5f5f539a11fe4f25ea59efde4149/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Dark/large/zuckusswithsnarerifle.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual23-Dark/large/zuckusswithsnarerifle.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/01510164a92d5f5f539a11fe4f25ea59efde4149 0151016] “Minor fixes”, 2 August 2024.</ref> prints: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Once per game, may peek at top card of any Reserve Deck. Permanent weapon is •Zuckuss’ Snare Rifle (may target a character for free; draw destiny; target excluded from battle if destiny +1 &gt; target’s power).” '''What changed:''' The words of the game text are unchanged. The third stat box, empty on the first image, now prints “FORCE-SENSITIVE”. It is a version of its own because the PC published a visibly different card image (Bill, 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC image is its own version). The card image prints no errata mark.
